claim: Datadog-style incident timeline fixtures situate real Patchline data-change findings on a reconstructed incident timeline: a deploy marker, an APM span, an error log, and a monitor alert per finding, all tagged with the affected table and finding id and ordered deploy < span < log < alert. The fixtures let reviewers exercise deploy-to-data-change correlation offline without a live observability backend.
incident_title: Elevated write errors after migration deploy
